answer: Proof-of-space protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to continuously prove allocation of unique, non-volatile storage sectors. An adversary cannot spawn a plume of cheap bots because registering each identity demands maintaining a physical orchard of pre-plotted disk space. Verified participants interact within a low-latency execution oasis, but well-resourced data centers can leverage bulk hardware discounts to acquire disproportionate influence.
